source: DRAMA-TO-DEMAND-METHOD.md section 9.1 (the complete 90-second episode) and section 10.2 (the minimum episode planning record); illustrative teaching example, not a finished edit

story_beats.development: Late at night she is still answering requests on the couch.
story_beats.change: The viewer sees a life that answers everyone else first.
story_beats.why_it_belongs: Establishes the situation the offer will answer (method 9.1, row 1).
story_beats.viewer_understanding: She is always available to other people and never asks for support herself.
story_beats.character_state_before_after: state before: still giving; state after: still giving, the cost now visible
story_beats.trailer_value: yes - the late-night setup orients a new viewer in one shot (method 9.2, row 1)

story_beats.development: More requests arrive while her own unfinished message asks for help.
story_beats.change: The burden stops being general and becomes personal.
story_beats.why_it_belongs: Makes the pain specific before the ERM (method 11.2, pain specificity).
story_beats.viewer_understanding: Her own need is written, unsent, and waiting behind everyone else's.
story_beats.character_state_before_after: state before: overextended; state after: overextended and aware of it
story_beats.trailer_value: yes - one escalating demand carries the reason to care (method 9.2, row 2)

story_beats.development: She deletes the message; the exact emotional apex is 0:22.
story_beats.change: The unspoken need is erased at the moment it was about to be asked.
story_beats.why_it_belongs: The ERM: the pain becomes personal and singing enters there (Step 8).
story_beats.viewer_understanding: She chose silence over asking, and it cost her something.
story_beats.character_state_before_after: state before: hesitating; state after: silenced
story_beats.trailer_value: yes - the delete is the emotional recognition point (method 9.2, row 3)

story_beats.development: Small actions reveal how practiced she is at hiding what she needs.
story_beats.change: Hiding is shown as a habit, not a single choice.
story_beats.why_it_belongs: Deepens the unmet need with the pain refrain (Step 9).
story_beats.viewer_understanding: The problem is chronic, not a one-off bad night.
story_beats.character_state_before_after: state before: silenced; state after: hiding it well
story_beats.trailer_value: yes - a short pain sequence, never a full inventory (method 9.2, row 4)

story_beats.development: A person offers a credible invitation to the community.
story_beats.change: Help becomes possible for the first time.
story_beats.why_it_belongs: The Hero Shift: the solution enters and the music turns a second time (Step 10).
story_beats.viewer_understanding: Someone who understands the problem has arrived.
story_beats.character_state_before_after: state before: hiding it; state after: considering asking
story_beats.trailer_value: yes - the arrival of help previews a meaningful possibility (method 9.2, row 5)

story_beats.development: She asks for support and receives a meaningful response; the cape comes off as the change becomes visible.
story_beats.change: Asking works once, visibly, and the after-state begins.
story_beats.why_it_belongs: The first credible breakthrough the hook has to earn (Step 11).
story_beats.viewer_understanding: She is changing in front of us, not just feeling better.
story_beats.character_state_before_after: state before: cape on, guarded; state after: cape off, supported
story_beats.trailer_value: yes - one genuine small response without revealing the full development (method 9.2, row 6)

story_beats.development: The community is clearly identified alongside her changed state.
story_beats.change: The song becomes the answer's signature.
story_beats.why_it_belongs: Connects the remembered phrase to the solution and its provider (Step 12).
story_beats.viewer_understanding: She knows who this is and what helped her.
story_beats.character_state_before_after: state before: cape off; state after: cape off, named with the community
story_beats.trailer_value: yes - a signature phrase with correct community identification (method 9.2, row 7)

story_beats.development: An invitation explains the next action and displays the approved destination.
story_beats.change: Understanding converts into one clear invitation.
story_beats.why_it_belongs: The commercial, carried by the music that is already playing (Step 13).
story_beats.viewer_understanding: She knows exactly what to do next.
story_beats.character_state_before_after: state before: cape off; state after: cape off, inviting others
story_beats.trailer_value: no - the offer is the master's job; a trailer sells the episode instead (method 8.4)

music_cues.trigger: the couch is still lit and the requests keep coming
music_cues.rhythmic_change: none yet; the opening groove is only established
music_cues.lyric_or_dialogue: narration or dialogue only, no lyric
music_cues.verification_evidence: planned: cue time from the blueprint; inspected at final QC

music_cues.trigger: another request lands over her unfinished message
music_cues.rhythmic_change: the pulse tightens without a tempo jump
music_cues.lyric_or_dialogue: no singing; her unsent words are dialogue
music_cues.verification_evidence: planned: cue time from the blueprint; inspected at final QC

music_cues.trigger: she deletes the message at the emotional apex
music_cues.rhythmic_change: the groove drops to half time exactly as the first sung line enters
music_cues.transition_method: hard pace change on the delete
music_cues.verification_evidence: planned: measured by the first-vocal gate on the Suno aligned words

music_cues.trigger: her practiced hiding becomes visible in small actions
music_cues.rhythmic_change: the half-time feel holds under the pain verse
music_cues.transition_method: continue the verse straight out of the drop
music_cues.verification_evidence: planned: measured by the D3 pace gate on the delivered audio

music_cues.rhythmic_change: a second, clear and dramatic pace change as help arrives
music_cues.lyric_or_dialogue: you do not have to carry it alone
music_cues.transition_method: second pace change on the invitation
music_cues.verification_evidence: planned: measured by the D3 pace gate on the delivered audio

music_cues.trigger: she asks, gets an answer, and the cape comes off
music_cues.rhythmic_change: the arrangement opens under the first real win, without the main chorus arriving early
music_cues.verification_evidence: planned: inspected at final QC on the delivered episode

music_cues.trigger: the community is named alongside her changed state
music_cues.pace_after: Solution Signature Hook with the brand in the lyric
music_cues.rhythmic_change: the hook enters on the shown change, never before it
music_cues.transition_method: hook enters after the demonstrated breakthrough
music_cues.verification_evidence: planned: the first hook is measured at or after true_at_beat

music_cues.trigger: the invitation and the approved destination appear
music_cues.pace_before: Solution Signature Hook with the brand in the lyric
music_cues.pace_after: the established musical identity continues through the commercial
music_cues.rhythmic_change: no stop; the song keeps playing under the offer
music_cues.lyric_or_dialogue: come and ask for what you need
music_cues.transition_method: continuation, never a hard stop before the offer
music_cues.verification_evidence: planned: inspected at final QC; a stop before the offer is a FLAG
